title: OXO Good Grips Soft Handled Can Opener $15.99 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: OXO Good Grips Soft Handled Can Opener $15.99 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU

[bgazer] I rarely use a can opener, but a couple of times a year when the tab breaks before the can is opened, it's good to have a can opener around. Some cans also don't have pull-tabs, such as larger red salmon cans.
[safrane] Yeah you might want to keep one as backup, if that's the case the IKEA Koncis can opener is only $3.99 I've never used it ever since I brought one of those.
[bcYield] This one is just 10x the price. Why complaining?
[DealDevourer] Canned betroot is notorious for not having a ring pull.
[plmko] Lol tell us you don't cook without telling
[bcYield] Essential for the camping life. Canned food is still the king.
[Postal Dude] Can vouch for their support, the silicone came off my old one from 10 or so years ago, they had no problem replacing it
[cobknob] Exceptionally solid and premium s/steel can opener.
[bcYield] Material: Stainless Steel
Is it made of better grading stainless steel than the Ikea's one?
[cobknob] No idea but I simply rinse with hot water and dry it with paper towel. Haven't seen any rust and works a charm opening cans.
[Stingstang] Thanks. Got one! Hope this one doesn't break like all the other can openersni have had
[asyik] It shows up as $19.99….. what did I do wrong
[DealDevourer] There is a $4 discount applied at checkout
[Newgod] Been looking for the best can opener and imo Kuhh Rikon lid lifter has the best design - no sharp edge and no food contact, very hygienic and avoid rusting from acidic food.
https://www.amazon.com.au/gp/product/B000I7GST2?smid=ANEGB3W…
[frondono] swing-a-ways are the goat
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0000505IZ
[Newgod] My in-law has one, it’s durable but got rusty badly so we tried to avoid any design that touches the food. The swing-a-way’s carbon steel blade is good to keep its sharpness but more prone to rust.
[scepticpsych] Is this really that much better than a $3.99 can opener from ikea
[bcYield] Would give this ago if under $10. Ikea's one is a bait. They don't make profits from these. So good value.
[bargaino] No profit? Check out Alibaba. Even in small quantities they are under a dollar.
[Ttbblsd] I am confused as well. IKEA's can opener is good enough for me.
